bullets.note: This is an incredible tool for taming anger, self-flagellation, and other reactive behaviors and patterns that handicap us. Especially if you’re a perfectionist, read the first 10% of this book, even if (especially if?) you claim to have no time. Trust me.

I was introduced to oregano oil by a world record holder in powerlifting years ago. In my n-of-1 experience, it appears to help shorten cold-like symptoms. I’m not aware of any published studies that support this application, and it could be simple regression to the mean, but [there are some interesting papers on carvacrol](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/5qu8lqg33u7ho2r09/pnceh9/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubmNiaS5ubG0ubmloLmdvdi9wdWJtZWQvMjUwNTg4Nzg=). Here is one thing beyond debate: you should NOT get the oil in your eyes — watch your hands — or take 2-3x the recommended number of drops. The burn is like salt on a wound.
